reviewNotes: All twenty-seven global event messages are translated directly from English. Birth, adoption and naming strings preserve placeholder roles while avoiding agreement failures for either child sex; animal births preserve mother/species positions. Night-event notices and the comet sequence retain tone. Piața de Noapte follows the approved glossary.
